title: claude-finops: two faces, one engine, three backends
subtitle: Pending merge · source pinned to the claude-finops branch at 00f296a. This is an administrative client of existing services, not another gateway in the inference path.

backends.excerpt:
from .fake import FakeBackend
from .direct import DirectBackend
from .turnstile import TurnstileBackend

groups.title: Operator's terminal · local process, not an authorization boundary

nodes.title: Textual terminal UI
lines: [[app]]: tabs, search, preview and explicit apply
Keyboard-first; 80 x 24 and larger terminals

nodes.title: Typer commands
lines: Scriptable nouns and verbs over the same operations
JSON, plain text and chargeback CSV output

nodes.title: One [[engine]]
lines: Current month, caller identity and scope; shared validation and budget arithmetic
Preview first. Explicit apply; confirm destructive changes.
Saved, pending, failed and verified are different states.
Local checks explain failures; the backend service still authorizes every request.

nodes.title: Turnstile HTTP backend
lines: [[turnstile]]
HTTPS + Azure CLI token for [[scope]]
Catalog, tiers, budgets, usage, people, requests and apply status
GET may refresh once; writes never retry.

nodes.title: Direct Azure backend
lines: [[direct]]
Azure CLI sign-in; ARM and Log Analytics
PowerShell bridge: [[bridge]]
Reuses gateway scripts and [[ledger]]; reads changes back.

nodes.title: Fake backend
lines: [[fake]]
Deterministic Contoso fixture data
Tests and terminal snapshots
Explicit selection only; never a fallback when a real service fails.

nodes.title: Server-side roles and scope
lines: Turnstile API checks app roles and manager scope.
PostgreSQL holds console state.
The gateway's apply job later publishes governance to APIM.

nodes.title: Azure RBAC is authoritative
lines: ARM reads / writes permitted gateway named values.
Log Analytics answers usage queries.
Direct mode does not inherit a Turnstile manager's delegated scope.

nodes.title: No tenant or model calls
lines: No Azure credentials required.
Fixture writes stay in memory.
Tests exercise the same engine and both user-facing workflows.

notice: Pending does not mean deployed. Re-render after the CLI merges. A Turnstile person budget is not an APIM daily quota override, and a saved console value is not proof that the gateway has applied it. Cost is estimated, not an Azure invoice.
